description: This file defines the PartyRelationshipServices class containing services related to maintenance of Party Relationships in the OFBiz framework. It includes methods to create and update party relationships, handling associated party roles and relationship history.

classes.name: PartyRelationshipServices
classes.description: A service class providing methods to manage Party Relationships, including creating and updating relationships along with associated roles.

methods.name: createUpdatePartyRelationshipAndRoles
methods.description: Creates or updates a PartyRelationship and associated PartyRoles, maintaining relationship history and ensuring the existence of roles. It handles creation of roles if they do not exist and manages relationship history to ensure only the latest relationship is active.
